declaration.negotiation_history_statement: As interim class counsel, we negotiated the settlement with defense counsel in confidential mediation communications. I do not disclose the parties’ confidential offers or statements. The resulting agreement provides a $29 million class fund, distributed automatically to identified class members without a claims process. Brightline will separately pay up to $2 million in attorneys’ fees and expenses, subject to court approval. Brightline has not agreed to refrain from opposing the fee request, and any fees not awarded will go to the class rather than revert to Brightline. The settlement reflects the substantial value of the claims alongside the risks of class certification, trial, and delay. Whitcombe Reyes LLP’s compensation is fixed regardless of the outcome; any approved settlement fee is paid to the foundation funding the litigation, not to the firm. In my judgment, the settlement warrants preliminary approval, subject to the Court’s independent review and class-member notice.
